QuestInfo.name: Correcting the Past 3: Catching Up to Tortoise
QuestInfo.0: Future Doctor Bing is looking for someone to prevent the delivery of materials to the Processing Plant.
QuestInfo.1: Go to the Underground Passage in the past using the #b#p9250138##k and defeat the #b#o9420073#s#k that are delivering materials for the Time Machine.
QuestInfo.2: You prevented the Time Machine materials from being delivered to the Processing Plant.

0.0: Do you remember what happened in the Underground Passage? You delivered the materials to the Processing Plant.
0.1: I will send you to the Underground Passage of the past using a black whole activation device.\r\nYou will be fighting against OS4 Shuttles like the one you drove in the past.
0.2: Defeat as many shuttles as you can so the Time Machine materials won't be delivered to the Processing Plant.\n\rThe shuttles are strong, so the people inside shouldn't get hurt.

yes.0: Don't worry, the pilots won't get hurt. Now, hurry!

no.0: Do you not have the courage to confront your pass self?

1.0: You're back! Thanks to you, we were able to stop much of the materials from reaching the plant.

yes.0: Still, the deliveries will continue. Please help us again tomorrow!

default.0: There are still OS4 Shuttles making their delivery! Fix the past!
